t: Cursor Freedom: Flow-State, FOSS, and the Switch to Gemini CLI
s: This article details a developer's transition from a proprietary AI coding assistant (Cursor AI) to a FOSS command-line tool (Gemini CLI), emphasizing the value of software freedom and optimized keyboard-centric workflows for achieving 'flow-state'.
sub: Shift from Cursor AI (VSCode-based) to Gemini CLI (FOSS)
Importance of Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) for developer control
Optimizing developer workflow for 'flow-state' via virtual desktops and keyboard navigation
Critique of proprietary AI tools and 'vendor lock-in'
Keyboard-centric workflow principles vs. GUI 'hunt-and-peck' methods
